title: ⏳ Minimal Text Fade Loader with CSS Animation ✨
description:
It's Minimal Text Fade Loader using HTML and CSS! This lightweight project features a bold "Loading..." text that fades in and out smoothly, perfect for adding a simple yet elegant loading indicator to any webpage. No JavaScript needed—just pure CSS magic! 🌟

  • What’s it about? A text-based loader that uses CSS keyframes to animate opacity for a fading effect.

  • The result? A clean, looping animation that signals loading in style.

  • Main key of the code: The @keyframes rule drives the opacity change, paired with animation properties for infinite alternation.

  • How can users benefit? Drop it into your site as a quick loading indicator, customize the text, font, or timing to match your design, or learn basic CSS animation!
shortDescription: 💡 A fading "Loading..." text animation, built with pure CSS. Simple and sleek!
